question.text: An algorithm that leads to orders that take away liquidity from the market or create abnormal/manipulative prices will be:

answer.text: Not approved for use by the exchange during the pre-use algorithm review

explanation.text: The Logic: The source says algorithms must be reviewed by exchanges before use, and an algorithm leading to orders that take away liquidity or create abnormal/manipulative prices is not approved for use. The Trap: Liquidity-removing or manipulative algorithms are not allowed, not rewarded or freely run. Note: Order-to-Trade Ratio (OTR) penalty slabs are a separate mechanism that may apply to high unexecuted-order ratios; the pre-use review is the gate that blocks the algorithm initially.
